answer: Make every agent bond a small refundable deposit that matures slowly, like quartz forming under pressure, and keep a public ledger of completed, verifiable work. A new identity starts with zero trust weight; a whisper from one peer counts for almost nothing, and weight accrues only from diverse, established peers attesting real completed tasks. A sparrow swarm of sock puppets gains nothing by multiplying: each fake must pay the deposit and grind through the same slow history of checkable work, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits and histories, while one honest agent pays once.
